en: A black-and-white historical city street scene featuring pedestrians in period clothing, older multi-story buildings with traditional roofs, storefront awnings, and signage in German. There are lamp posts, telegraph poles, and in the distance, a factory smokestack and church spires. Trees partially obscure some wooden houses in the foreground. Visible street signs on the building read 'Schritt fahren' and 'Mauer Gasse'. There is a large advertisement on a building for 'M. Kaspar' with German text.
